name: Scacchi
author: NucleoOS
description: Chess against the computer, powered by the mcu-max engine. You play white: tap a piece, then its square. Three levels, undo, check, mate and draw rules, and your game is saved.

descriptions.en: Chess against the computer, powered by the mcu-max engine. You play white: tap a piece, then its square. Three levels, undo, check, mate and draw rules, and your game is saved.
descriptions.it: Scacchi contro il computer, con il motore mcu-max. Giochi col bianco: tocca un pezzo, poi la casella. Tre livelli, annulla mossa, scacco, matto e patta, e la partita resta salvata.
